description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs: `verify_delta_crl_and_collect` now returns `&'a [RevokedCert]` instead of `Vec<RevokedCert>`, eliminating a clone of the entire revoked-certificates list on every CRL check. The `delta_entries` local in both `check_revocation` and `check_revocation_against_anchor` is now `&[RevokedCert]` with `&[]` as the no-delta fallback. Clean lifetime threading, no semantic change.
title: Good: delta CRL borrow-not-clone
